note: Bytes of script and style a page carries before its first view (tools/first-view-budget.mjs). Measured 2026-11-19: each stand 2,647,932 bytes in the default build, the home page 57,050. Measured again 2026-11-22 in the publication's own build, with the layers present, after the agents' interface (#501) and the Population (#500) joined the stands' first view: each stand 2,962,003 bytes (2,861,271 without the layers), the home page 58,066. The limits keep a tenth of room for ordinary growth and stop a large data file or library coming back into the first view.
